scope: Single-context exact shared-policy composition and a short fresh no-tool Codex A/B fixture with server usage; not a long-paper benchmark, full chat bill, or 100 completed upgrades.

implementation.procedure: Inspect fixed entry scopes, exact version comparison, unique text preservation and standalone source hashes.
implementation.acceptance: No unique, conflicting, quoted or ambiguous policy text removed; CLI entry uses the implementation.

reference_boundary.procedure: Replay differing/ambiguous/fence/symlink/cap cases and unchanged standalone sources.
reference_boundary.acceptance: Unsafe scopes retained or rejected before dispatch; no persistent context cache or guide writes.

data_integrity.procedure: Read raw fresh-thread JSONL and bound fixture/config/source hashes; inspect actual outcome types.
data_integrity.acceptance: Exactly one completed turn per invocation, no tools/subagents or failures, no missing or duplicate usage; independent checker recomputes actual totals.

numerical_sanity.procedure: Total each terminal input+output; cached input is a subset; compare A/B and fixed output oracle.
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Both outputs satisfy all short fixture constraints, combined total<=50000 and candidate total strictly lower; no estimates counted.

measurement_validity.procedure: Same native binary, model/config, question and schema; exact prompts differ only in declared policy sharing. Check quota and bounded calls.
measurement_validity.acceptance: Two calls max, zero retries, supplied prompt<=2200 chars, 90-second timeout; first total<=25000 before second. Provider used windows<90% and ordinary usage allowed. Scope only this actual pair.

reproducibility.procedure: Separate host process replays deterministic composer/oracle and targeted regressions using the bound source.
reproducibility.acceptance: Source, input and provider usage bindings agree; no extra model call for verification, no whole-agent quality or general long-context gain inferred.
